short: The v1 proto corpus (session, account, commission, den, bug report, problem)
is: The v1 corpus — package `zurfur.api.v1`, one `.proto` per surface (session, account, commission, den, bug report, error), welded to `/api/v1`.
conventions: Every file opens with a plain-language orientation header (no cross-repo pointers — see Refs below for what each header used to cite).
`service`/`rpc` blocks only declare routes for the descriptor test; only messages are generated.
Vocabularies are strings with known values documented inline (R8).
Request messages exist even when empty ("the session is the argument").
Success bodies are bare/flat resources, never wrapped; Problem `detail` is REQUIRED and never empty.
Field comments carry the semantic contract — normative, not decoration.
A field error's pointer is `#/` plus the field's lowerCamelCase ProtoJSON name; its detail is fixed per code.
entry_points: session.proto (smallest surface, shows the whole pattern)

fs.name: account.proto
fs.role: ListAccounts, CreateAccount, ChangeHandle (PATCH /accounts/{id}/handle), DeleteAccount, AccountMembership (now carries an alias field); AccountService

fs.name: bug_report.proto
fs.role: FileBugReport (POST /bug-reports): a signed-in visitor files a bug report; the reporter comes from the session, no field names one; the receipt carries a short reference and received_at; BugReportService

fs.name: commission.proto
fs.role: CreateCommission (owner POV), RenameCommission (PATCH /commissions/{id}/title, owner-only, answers the commission as stored), GetCommission (GET /commissions/{id}: the fields every opener may see, never the owner nor the linked channel, whose number 9 and name `linked_channel` its answer reserves, the deadline status at the request's time (while disputed, read at the dispute's start), the viewer's acts by word and lifecycle targets, empty for someone with no role), MoveCommissionLifecycle (PUT …/lifecycle, 204, a bad step a 422 at #/to), RaiseCommissionDispute and ClearCommissionDispute (PUT and DELETE …/dispute, 204, no body; 409 commission_disputed for a second raise, commission_not_disputed for a clear when not disputed), and the direction, deadline and Delayed sets and clears (PUT/DELETE …/status/direction, …/deadline, …/status/deadline, 204, today's bodies), each with its own empty response message and its answers in its comment; Maturity; google.protobuf.Timestamp; CommissionService. The owner's list (ListCommissions) is retired.

fs.name: den.proto
fs.role: GetDenRoot (GET /den), GetDenNode (GET /den/{path=**}): a signed-in viewer reads their own Den one node at a time; an open node names the thing it stands for (`DenOpen.thing`), a crumb carries its type; a node and a crumb carry `name_ordinal` when another entry the viewer sees in the same folder shows the same name; DenService

fs.name: problem.proto
fs.role: the RFC 9457 Problem shape declared ONCE for every surface; also FieldError, the request fields a problem refused

notes: See also: ZMVP-152 (account.proto: `DeleteAccountResponse.outcome` — the delete AC that needs the outcome distinguished).
See also: PDD 0.1 D-28 (commission.proto: the owner's list, `ListCommissions`, is retired as a declared baseline reset; the Den's `commissions` folder replaces it).
See also: Engineer ruling 2026-07-24 (account.proto: `ListAccounts` returns every role the caller holds, not owned-only).

See also: Engineer ruling 2026-07-25, one ruling covering several call sites: account.proto (`DeleteAccountResponse` carries the outcome instead of a bodiless `204`), commission.proto (`CreateCommissionResponse`/`CreateCommission` carry the created resource so the caller can navigate to it), problem.proto (`Problem.detail` is required, resolving a prior three-way drift across problem.rs/plugin-v1.yaml/problem.ts), session.proto (R1: lowerCamelCase wire keys, `json_name` rejected as a one-way door).
